_comment: Controls the shared corner-logo + event-badge overlay drawn on every filter except Classic. All values are ratios (0.0-1.0) of the frame's own width/height, so they scale correctly on every device. Edit these directly and rebuild the app -- no script needed.
_logoSizeRatio_comment: Diameter of each corner logo, as a fraction of frame width.
_logoGapRatio_comment: Gap between the three corner logos.
_logoMargin_comment: Distance of the logo row from the top-right corner.
_badgeWidthRatio_comment: Width of the ENCODE 5.0 X ZENITHCUP badge, as a fraction of frame width (height follows its own aspect ratio).
_badgeInsetRatio_comment: How far the badge sits over the photo vs. over the frame border, at whichever bottom corner that filter uses. 0.65 means 65% of the badge's width overlaps the photo side, 35% overlaps the frame border. 0.5 would center it exactly on the corner.
